title: Release-prep-0-6-4
no_spec_change_rationale: A patch release changes no requirement text: the crate version becomes 0.6.4, the changelog fragments of merged changes are assembled into CHANGELOG.md, and the generated knowledge index is rebuilt.
acceptance_criteria: Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock say 0.6.4; CHANGELOG.md has a 0.6.4 section dated 2026-11-26 with every merged fragment from changelog.d, which is then empty, and its release link; fledge run release-check passes; cargo build --locked and cargo test --locked pass. Nothing is tagged or published.
